dom-3 error QuestionnaireResponse If the resource is contained in another resource, it SHALL be referred to from elsewhere in the resource or SHALL refer to the containing resource contained.where((('#'+id in (%resource.descendants().reference | %resource.descendants().as(canonical) | %resource.descendants().as(uri) | %resource.descendants().as(url))) or descendants().where(reference = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists() or descendants().where(as(canonical) = '#').exists()).not()).trace('unmatched', id).empty()

hn-iadls-1 error QuestionnaireResponse 暫存填是時，表單狀態必須為 in-progress。 item.where(linkId='IsTemporary').answer.value.ofType(Coding).where(code='cb5141d3d19e9').exists() implies status='in-progress'
hn-iadls-2 error QuestionnaireResponse 暫存填否時，表單狀態必須為 completed 或 amended。 item.where(linkId='IsTemporary').answer.value.ofType(Coding).where(code='c0c70665b6eb6').exists() implies (status='completed' or status='amended')
qrs-1 error QuestionnaireResponse.item, QuestionnaireResponse.item:Date, QuestionnaireResponse.item:NurseID, QuestionnaireResponse.item:Questions, QuestionnaireResponse.item:IsTemporary Nested item can't be beneath both item and answer (answer.exists() and item.exists()).not()

Constraints

Id Grade Path(s) Description Expression
hn-iadls-1 error QuestionnaireResponse 暫存填是時，表單狀態必須為 in-progress。 item.where(linkId='IsTemporary').answer.value.ofType(Coding).where(code='cb5141d3d19e9').exists() implies status='in-progress'
hn-iadls-2 error QuestionnaireResponse 暫存填否時，表單狀態必須為 completed 或 amended。 item.where(linkId='IsTemporary').answer.value.ofType(Coding).where(code='c0c70665b6eb6').exists() implies (status='completed' or status='amended')
